meaning.vi: (thông tục, hài hước) Ông nội, ông nội.

sentences.en: Good old gramps for playing the game with her that triggered it!
sentences.vi: Những ông già tốt bụng vì đã chơi trò chơi với cô ấy mà đã kích hoạt nó!

sentences.en: So, I asked Joseph's father, Gramps, did he smoke?
sentences.vi: Vì vậy, tôi hỏi cha của Joseph, Gramps, ông ấy có hút thuốc không?

sentences.en: Beloved husband of June, dearest dad of David and Linda and much loved gramps of Richard, Kate, Andrew and Rebecca.

sentences.en: Oh, Gramps, she thought tiredly, what a nice little legacy you left your granddaughter.
sentences.vi: Ôi, Bà ơi, bà mệt mỏi nghĩ, ông để lại cho cháu gái mình một di sản nhỏ nhoi nào.

sentences.en: How is Gramps different from the boy?
sentences.vi: Gramps khác với cậu bé như thế nào?

sentences.en: Old gramps will even act as your assistant.

sentences.en: But Gramps and Gran are going to the meeting, too. So Brother and Sister can't stay with them.

sentences.en: "I wouldn't be surprised, " replied Gramps . "One's in your coffee and the other is in your oatmeal.

sentences.en: For GRAMPS 3.1, the memory requirements have been reduced, and GRAMPS can run quite efficiently on a 256MB system, holding considerably more people.
